alternatives_rejected.why: An injected delay would raise latency without a large CPU spike. E1 shows productcatalogservice_cpu z=36.22 (607.1%) alongside its latency jump, which fits CPU saturation.

Its latency deviation is about half of productcatalogservice's (E1: z=97.94 vs z=182.68), and it has no CPU anomaly. The slowest failing traces in E2 route through productcatalogservice, so recommendationservice's slowness is downstream impact.

proposed_fix.description: Find and stop the CPU-hogging process in the productcatalogservice pods. Temporarily scale out productcatalogservice replicas and raise its CPU limits to restore latency, then confirm that latency-90 and CPU return to baseline.
